title: Replace Google authentication with admin-controlled username/password system

requirements.text: Remove all Internet Identity and Google authentication dependencies from the frontend, including the useInternetIdentity hook, AuthClient usage, and Internet Identity provider wrapper

quotes: only admins create accounts for students/staff and provide id and password

acceptanceCriteria: Internet Identity provider is removed from main.tsx
useInternetIdentity hook is no longer used in any components
AuthClient dependencies are removed from the codebase
No references to Internet Identity remain in authentication flow

requirements.text: Implement a traditional username/password login form on the LoginPage component replacing the 'Sign in with Google' button, with fields for username/ID and password, maintaining the dark mode styling

quotes: Replace the current 'Sign in with Google' button with a traditional username/password login

acceptanceCriteria: LoginPage displays username/ID input field
LoginPage displays password input field with obscured text
Submit button is present and functional
Dark mode styling is maintained consistent with current design
Form validation prevents empty submissions

requirements.text: Create backend Motoko functions to securely store user credentials with password hashing, supporting user creation with username, hashed password, role (admin/staff/student), and name fields

quotes: Secure Backend Storage - Implement secure credential storage in Motoko with proper password hashing

acceptanceCriteria: Password hashing algorithm is implemented in Motoko
User credential storage includes username, hashed password, role, and name
Passwords are never stored in plain text
createUser function is available for admin use only
Credential data persists across canister upgrades

requirements.text: Implement backend authentication function that verifies username and password credentials, returns a session token or user identity on success, and supports role-based access control

quotes: Students and staff will log in using credentials created by admins

acceptanceCriteria: authenticateUser function verifies username and password
Function returns user profile including role on successful authentication
Function returns error message on failed authentication
Session management mechanism is implemented
Authentication state persists across page refreshes

requirements.text: Create an admin-only account creation interface accessible from the Layout navigation menu, with form fields for username/ID, password, role selection (Admin/Teacher/Staff/Student), and name

quotes: Admin Account Creation Panel - Build an interface where admins can create new accounts for students and staff

acceptanceCriteria: New navigation menu item visible only to admins
Account creation page includes username/ID input field
Password input field is present with visibility toggle
Role dropdown includes Admin, Teacher, Staff, and Student options
Name input field is included
Form submission calls backend createUser function
Success message displays after account creation
Form validation prevents duplicate usernames

requirements.text: Update the useAuth hook to manage username/password authentication state instead of Internet Identity, including login, logout, and session persistence functionality

quotes: Replace Google/Internet Identity authentication with username/password login system

acceptanceCriteria: useAuth hook no longer depends on Internet Identity
Hook provides login function accepting username and password
Hook provides logout function that clears authentication state
Authentication state persists in browser storage
Hook returns current user profile and role information
isAuthenticated and isAdmin flags are correctly computed

requirements.text: Update the useActor hook to initialize the backend actor with session-based authentication instead of Internet Identity principal

quotes: Implement secure backend credential storage with password hashing in Motoko

acceptanceCriteria: useActor no longer depends on Internet Identity
Actor initialization uses session token or authentication state
Backend calls include authentication credentials
Actor invalidates queries on authentication state changes

requirements.text: Remove the ProfileSetupModal component since user profiles will be created by admins during account creation with all necessary information

quotes: only admins create accounts for students/staff and provide id and password

acceptanceCriteria: ProfileSetupModal component is removed from the codebase
App.tsx no longer displays the profile setup modal
User profiles are fully populated upon account creation
No first-time setup flow is required for new users

requirements.text: Update backend migration.mo to preserve existing user profile data during the transition from Internet Identity to username/password authentication system
acceptanceCriteria: migration.mo includes logic to preserve existing userProfiles Map data
Existing user profiles are associated with new credential system
No data loss occurs during canister upgrade
Migration handles empty state gracefully for fresh deployments

constraints: Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx (these will be removed entirely)
Preserve existing student, marks, attendance, and subject management functionality
Keep dark mode styling consistent with current LoginPage design
Maintain role-based access control for admin features
nonGoals: Password reset or forgot password functionality
Account self-registration by students or staff
Batch account import from CSV or external sources
